headerDisplay: Adds your Porsche to Apple Home. **First run: sign in above with your Porsche ID** (email, password, and a captcha image if prompted) — after that the plugin runs headless via the refresh token. You can also use the `porsche-auth` CLI. See the README for details.
footerDisplay: Unofficial, reverse-engineered API. If you hit "tokens lost" errors, run `porsche-auth` again.

vehicleName.title: Display name
vehicleName.description: Names every accessory in the Home app and titles the charging dashboard, including its browser tab and home-screen icon.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the HomeKit tile names.

vehicleModel.title: Model (HomeKit device details)
vehicleModel.description: Shown as the Model in each accessory's details (e.g. Taycan, Macan).

detailLevel.title: Tile scope
detailLevel.description: "Essential" shows only the most important everyday tiles. "Full" shows the complete cockpit (all ~55 tiles).

vehicleType.title: Drivetrain
vehicleType.description: Controls the energy tiles. "Electric" = charge level/range/charging. "Combustion" = fuel level/range. "Plug-in hybrid" = both. Note: only electric (Taycan) is live-tested.

spin.title: Porsche S-PIN (for unlocking)
spin.description: 4-digit security PIN from the My Porsche app. Only needed for UNLOCKING via Apple Home. Leave empty = the lock can only lock. Stored in plain text in the Homebridge config.

pricePerKwhCt.title: Electricity price (ct/kWh)
pricePerKwhCt.description: Your energy price per kWh in cents. Leave at 0 to hide all cost figures — a made-up price would be worse than none.

chargingBonusCt.title: Charging bonus (ct/kWh)
chargingBonusCt.description: Discount per kWh deducted from the price, e.g. for tariff-controlled charging. Effective price = price minus bonus.

capacityKwh.title: Usable battery capacity (kWh)
capacityKwh.description: Net usable capacity. Charged energy is derived from the state-of-charge delta times this value. The dashboard measures your real capacity from driving data and shows it next to this setting.

dashboardPort.title: Charging dashboard port
dashboardPort.description: Port of the built-in charging history dashboard. It binds to ALL network interfaces and has NO password — anyone who can reach this port can read your charging history. Keep it off the public internet. Set to 0 to disable the dashboard entirely.

pluggedPollMinutes.title: Poll interval while plugged in (min)
pluggedPollMinutes.description: How often to poll while the cable is connected. May go below the 10-minute floor: the car is on mains power, so the 12V concern does not apply. Lower values catch short tariff windows.

dayBoundaryHour.title: Day starts at (hour)
dayBoundaryHour.description: Hour at which a new day begins for the statistics. Default 0 splits an overnight charge across both days; set to e.g. 4 so a 22:00-06:00 charge counts towards the evening it started.

ntfyTopic.title: ntfy topic (push notifications)
ntfyTopic.description: Topic on the ntfy server. Leave empty to disable push. Choose something unguessable — ntfy topics are publicly addressable.

ntfyServer.title: ntfy server
ntfyServer.description: Push server. Change only if you self-host ntfy.

dailyPushHour.title: Daily report hour
dailyPushHour.description: Local hour for the daily charging report. Set to -1 to disable.

pushOnChargeEnd.title: Notify when charging ends
pushOnChargeEnd.description: Send a push when the car is unplugged, summarising the completed charge.

items.helpvalue:
The plugin records every poll and reconstructs your charging sessions from it. A dashboard on your local network shows them by day, week, month and year.

Costs are opt-in: leave the price at 0 and no cost figures appear anywhere — a made-up price would be worse than none.
Optional. Leave the topic empty to disable push entirely — nothing is sent and no connection is made.
